A diamond anniversary marks **60 years of marriage** , symbolizing an unbreakable bond that is rare, enduring, and formed through time.[[1]](https://attajewelry.com/blogs/love-jewelry/diamond-wedding-anniversary-meaning-gift-ideas-amp-celebration-tips-for-60-years-of-love)[[2]](https://diamondsinglass.com/en/journal/diamantene-hochzeit)

### Meaning and History

- **Symbolism:** Diamonds represent ultimate strength, deep love, and a relationship that cannot be easily broken.[[1]](https://www.i-diamants.com/en/news/wedding/60-ans-de-mariage-noces-de-diamant-signification-et-idees-cadeaux.html,119)[[2]](https://attajewelry.com/blogs/love-jewelry/diamond-wedding-anniversary-meaning-gift-ideas-amp-celebration-tips-for-60-years-of-love)
- **Origin:** The 60-year milestone became widely known as the diamond anniversary after Queen Victoria celebrated her [Diamond Jubilee](https://www.i-diamants.com/en/news/wedding/60-ans-de-mariage-noces-de-diamant-signification-et-idees-cadeaux.html,119) in 1897. Before that event, a diamond milestone traditionally marked 75 years.[[1]](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/diamond_anniversary)[[2]](https://www.vrai.com/journal/post/diamond-anniversary-guide)[[3]](https://attajewelry.com/blogs/love-jewelry/diamond-wedding-anniversary-meaning-gift-ideas-amp-celebration-tips-for-60-years-of-love)
- **Colors and Flowers:** White is the classic color for the 60th anniversary, and the iris is the traditional flower, representing faith and wisdom.[[1]](https://myweddinganniversary.com/anniversaries/60th-year-anniversary/)

### Celebration and Gift Ideas

- **Gifts:** Traditional and modern guides suggest actual [diamond jewelry](https://myweddinganniversary.com/anniversaries/60th-year-anniversary/) , such as rings, earrings, or upgraded wedding bands.[[1]](https://www.jared.com/jewelry-education/wedding/anniversary-gifts-guide-by-year)[[2]](https://myweddinganniversary.com/anniversaries/60th-year-anniversary/)
- **Celebrations:** Many families host intimate gatherings, dinners at favorite restaurants, or short relaxing trips.[[1]](https://www.i-diamants.com/en/news/wedding/60-ans-de-mariage-noces-de-diamant-signification-et-idees-cadeaux.html,119)[[2]](https://myweddinganniversary.com/anniversaries/60th-year-anniversary/)
- **Special Honors:** Couples in Commonwealth countries can receive a special message or telegram from the reigning monarch.[[1]](https://myweddinganniversary.com/anniversaries/60th-year-anniversary/)
